sentences.en: I will have to get rid of this worn-out carpet.
sentences.zh: 我得把这张旧地毯处理掉了。

sentences.en: This carpet is big enough to cover the whole floor.
sentences.zh: 这张地毯足够大，可以铺满整个地板。

sentences.en: The price of the carpet is determined by three factors.
sentences.zh: 地毯的价格由三个因素决定。

senses.zh: 在…上铺地毯，把地毯铺在…上；斥责
